page.layout: One blank page of paper; no printed text, no blocks, no margins with text.
page.notes: The scan shows only the blank, discoloured surface of a leaf: uneven yellowish tone, a darker stain at the top left and a bluish cast along the right edge. No printed letters, numbers, running head, catchword or signature are visible. Specks and fibres are paper texture or show-through, not text, and are left out.
